prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a NEW large ink-refuelling installation sprite designed specifically for a side-scrolling industrial sewer game.
Input 1 exact sewer pipe asset is the strict MATERIAL AND RENDERING reference. Input 2 actual gameplay screenshot indicates stage palette, pixel density and available floor. Input 3 is the previous small U-frame machine design: ONLY the inverted-U structural idea, right-hand nozzle and centered black heart concept remain. REDESIGN its geometry and proportions from scratch for the larger installation, do not merely enlarge, stretch or upsample that machine.
Target display footprint about 118px wide x 108px high at gameplay scale, compared with a 64px tall player. A substantial utilitarian facility: wider low base with two separated sturdy foot mounts, two heavy vertical plumbing columns joined by a broad top elbow pipe, LARGE CENTRAL vertical rectangular INK TANK taking up most of the inner opening instead of a tiny hanging panel, mechanically attached to the frame at top and bottom; right-side accessible nozzle dock and bent hose connected to tank. More functional larger-volume construction, tighter organized negative space. Keep inverted-U silhouette recognizable. Camera straight-on shallow depth for side-scroller.
Centered on the central tank front, a BIG heart shaped inspection window filled 75% with dense BLACK ink, a small muted ivory air area above horizontal ink line. At game scale heart ~25px wide. No numbered gauge or tick marks, no text, no LEDs or neon.
Match input1 matte DARK muted blue-green industrial pipe shading, broad soft painted shadow planes discretized to game pixels, restrained dull metal edges, sparse grime. Do NOT reuse previous bright creamy outline tracing every piece or dense rust flecks or shiny bevelled cartoon metal. At target size frame pipe diameter ~12px, bolts ~2px, restrained clear edge contrast. Big design with intentionally thicker tank and wider support geometry, not a uniform rescale of previous.
One complete independent freestanding machine, transparent alpha background, no wall, floor or characters, no text, no sheet. Fill canvas with narrow transparent margins, grounded base completely visible.
